title: CI: launcher tests compare temp-alias paths with canonical paths and fail on GitHub's Windows and macOS runners
outcome:
Greg reported a GitHub CI failure, 2026-09-30 about 05:25Z: scripts/test-launcher.test.mjs test 21, "clean pass retains logs and summarizes without passing-test lists", assertion at :317.
The assertion computes relative(join(root, ".git", "review-runs"), runDir), expecting /^test-[^\\/]+$/.
The two paths are spelled differently:
- root comes from mkdtemp under testTempDirectory(), i.e. os.tmpdir(). On the runner that is the 8.3 short name C:\Users\RUNNER~1\AppData\Local\Temp.
- runDir comes from `git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-path review-runs`, which returns the long name C:\Users\runneradmin\….
So relative() climbs nine levels ("..\\" ×9 then "runneradmin\\…").
It passes locally only because the local temp path has no short-name component.
Classification: test defect. The product's run directory is correct; the test compares two spellings of the same directory.
Fix: compare canonical paths (fs.realpathSync.native on both sides), and check the other tests in the file for the same root-versus-Git path comparison.
acceptance: Each of the three helper scripts (test-launcher.mjs, test-temp-root.mjs, review-freeze-fingerprint.mjs) runs its main when started through a linked directory; a test starts all three that way and fails against the previous scripts.

No test in scripts/test-launcher.test.mjs compares a temp-derived path with a Git-reported or child-reported path without canonicalizing both, including the stage-cwd test's child-side and result-side checks.
The GitHub CI run on master at 28e9ed5, the last landing for this item, passes these tests on windows-latest and macos-latest.
With TERMAL_TEST_USER_TEMP set to an 8.3 short-name path, the launcher test file passes; before the fix the same run reproduces the CI failure at :317.

completion.summary: GitHub's "Review integrity helpers" workflow is green on Windows, macOS and Ubuntu again (run 36733526465 on 28e9ed5), after failing since at least 2026-09-26. Two causes were fixed. (1) The launcher tests compared temp-alias paths (Windows 8.3 short names, macOS /var) with canonical paths from Git and child processes; they now compare canonical paths (commit 9367f56). (2) A product defect in three helper scripts: their entry guards compared argv with Node's link-resolved module path, so a script started through a linked path exited 0 silently; they now compare canonical paths, and a new test starts all three through a linked directory (commit 28e9ed5). Both were reproduced on Windows before the fix. Lows are filed as w-3cbd685261fa and w-fdf78dca0a5e; the fingerprint instability found on the way is filed as w-3a48a8c03da7. The acceptance evaluation passed all four criteria.
